claim_ceiling: This policy metadata is test-only and does not establish production key custody, external trust, or deployment authorization. It models TUF-style role separation, key rotation state, and freeze/anti-rollback state for the finite ETP campaign. No production rotation process exists.

correction_authority.description: Correction and revocation authority is declared in the trust policy and exercised through the append-only registry.

freeze_state.description: Freeze state prevents new attestations from being accepted. The repository owner can freeze/unfreeze.

key_rotation_state.rotation_policy: A new attestation requires a new policy version and a new key entry. No production rotation process exists.

non_claims: This policy metadata is test-only and does not establish production key custody.
No production key rotation process exists.
No external trust, transparency, or witnessing is established.
A valid policy metadata does not establish truth, completeness, or deployment authorization.
The freeze state is administrative, not technical assurance.

roles.description: Produces closure, consumer-closure, and findings predicates
Qualifies an instrument and records reproduction
Admits proofs and, when the policy declares it independent, reviews

rollback_counter.description: Rollback counter must be monotonically non-decreasing. A decrease indicates a rollback attempt.
